chunks: And from him, from Ṣafwān and Faḍālah, from al-ʿAlāʾ, from Muḥammad, from one of the two عليهما السلام, who said:

I asked him about a woman riding together with a man in a litter: may they both perform salat together? He said: “No. Rather, the man should perform salat, and when he has finished, the woman should perform salat.”

key_terms.الرَّجُلَ: the man sharing the litter with her
key_terms.الْمَحْمِلِ: a riding litter or howdah mounted on an animal
key_terms.الْمَرْأَةِ: the woman being asked about in the ruling
key_terms.تُزَامِلُ: rides together closely with another in the same conveyance
key_terms.فَرَغَ: he completed and finished the prayer
key_terms.يُصَلِّيَانِ: the two of them perform salat

ai.seo_question: Can a man and a woman pray at the same time while riding together in the same litter?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling about salat in a confined shared riding space between a man and a woman. It states that they should not pray simultaneously there; instead, the man prays first, and when he finishes, the woman prays.
